subject.title: [Bug]: room_event forces message_tool_only despite visibleReplies=automatic, destabilizing prompt cache

question: Should the linked fix keep strict message_tool_only effective delivery for ambient room_event turns while using a session-stable prompt-facing delivery/tool inventory and provider cache-boundary split to preserve prompt-cache prefixes?
rationale: Current main partially separates stable prompt mode from effective delivery, but the remaining fix changes cache-visible tool/provider behavior and preserves a policy split that should be accepted by a maintainer before this issue closes.

options.title: Review and land the linked PR
options.body: Accept the split between effective delivery and prompt-facing cache stability, require any remaining live-cache proof or override on the PR, and close this issue after merge.

options.title: Narrow the PR
options.body: Keep only the room_event prompt-mode fix and defer owner-only tool inventory or Responses boundary behavior to narrower follow-ups.

options.title: Reject the split and document current behavior
options.body: Keep room_event prompt/tool churn as an intentional side effect of strict ambient-room delivery and update docs instead of changing runtime behavior.

recommendation.title: Review and land the linked PR
recommendation.body: Accept the split between effective delivery and prompt-facing cache stability, require any remaining live-cache proof or override on the PR, and close this issue after merge.
